title: M02 W37 four-shot motion-matched rough cut v2
reason_for_revision: User judged v1 overall acceptable but found the four cut points too hard, with a brief pause before the next shot. Source review also found held poses near the ends of both styling shots.

sequence.known_defect_outside_selection: blue shirt slips off shoulder after about 3.47s in source

output.format: WebM MediaRecorder browser canvas technical review output; cue-based seeking is unreliable

edit_method: Same four Grok source clips at normal speed. S02/S03 held tails trimmed; each next muted source starts 0.35s before its direct cut and is already moving when shown. No dissolve, wipe, speed change, music, or caption.

review.observed: The three reviewed cut neighborhoods show moving subjects immediately after each cut, with no black frame or held first frame in the visible samples. Both looks remain readable; S03 is limited to the pre-slip interval.
review.limits: Sampled replay is not proof of every frame, identity continuity, or user editorial approval. This is a silent, caption-free technical preview, not a publication master.
